name: GitHub - declared locales via code search
description: Read-only: runs eight GitHub code searches across the QR-CODE-App org to locate in-code locale declarations, fetches each candidate file and parses the enabled locale list, flagging repos where two files disagree.

parameters.jsCode:
const Q = [
  'DEFAULT_LOCALE org:QR-CODE-App',
  'SUPPORTED_LOCALES org:QR-CODE-App',
  'AVAILABLE_LOCALES org:QR-CODE-App',
  'availableLocales org:QR-CODE-App',
  'supportedLocales org:QR-CODE-App',
  'available_locales org:QR-CODE-App',
  'localePrefix org:QR-CODE-App',
  'defaultLocale org:QR-CODE-App'
];
return Q.map(q => ({ json: { q } }));
